question: wiki/open-questions.md item 4: can a warmup-time rule that adapts delta (max_error) from the OBSERVED level-0 leaf-error distribution keep the fixed-delta-2 gain (WP34 1.070x) where it exists and fall back to delta <= 1 where the leaf-error tail is heavy (accel_gp 0.68x under fixed 2; funnel gross safety 6/12 seeds under fixed 2, WP37A)?
change_under_test: WarmupConfig::with_adaptive_delta(AdaptiveDeltaConfig) (opt-in, off in every default). Every macro leaf attempted during a slow metric window contributes its level-0 endpoint energy error |H_end - H_start| (new kernel telemetry field MacroLeafOutcome::level_zero_energy_error, carried on the warmup trace events; infinite for an invalid level-0 evaluation) to a fixed 16-bins-per-decade log histogram over [1e-8, 1e8]. At each slow-window end the empirical p-quantile q (geometric interpolation in the bin) is mapped by the rule and clamped; installed for the following transitions. Guards copied from the v4 robust paper rule: finite clamp (no collapse toward 0), nothing installed in the initial fast phase, nothing installed before the metric has been installed at an EARLIER boundary (so the first window, ending at the first metric installation, is Deferred), a window with < 100 leaves is skipped. Installs only during discarded transitions: delta is frozen for every retained transition. Dual averaging of h continues through installs (no restart). Rejected with the paper rules, with an initial-phase max_error, and by the dense/structured-refresh/arrowhead facades.

Per seed: P(omega < -5) with the ArviZ-style indicator MCSE z (exact 0.0477903522728147), P(omega < -6) (exact 0.0227501319481792), omega variance (exact 9), rank R-hat, bulk/tail ESS, divergences, invalid stops, exhaustions, final delta per chain, delta trajectory. decision_rule.text: Recommend a candidate arm (r1 or r2) as the default iff ALL of: C1 geomean over the 17 models of the per-model ratio (seed-median min bulk ESS per gradient, warmup included, arm / da) >= 1.10; C2 no model's ratio < 0.85 (accel_gp included; a model without a ratio counts as failing C1 and C2); C3 cells passing all gates >= da's; C4 funnel |z| <= 2 on every study seed; C5 funnel gross safety (WP37A F3) passed on every study seed. If both qualify, the higher C1. d2 is a control and is never recommended. A qualifying arm is a recommendation only: per the shared brief no default changes on this branch. Report all cells; no reruns; failures are results; nothing tuned after seeing results.
